name: Lauren Book

items.text: On April 3, 2023, Book and Nikki Fried were arrested with nine others for trespass after warning. They stayed outside Tallahassee City Hall after sundown at a protest against a six-week abortion ban. Prosecutors dropped all charges, citing no criminal history and the group's cooperation. Book said she did not use the justice system to amplify a political agenda.
items.why: A peaceful, misdemeanor protest arrest with charges dropped is a petty moment that shows no abuse of office, self-dealing or dishonesty under any criterion, and her abortion stance is already covered by the platform score.

for_review: The owner-site search (alexjoneslive.com, stewpeters.com, ryandawson.org, infowars.com) returned nothing about Lauren Book. Book's quote about the dropped charges appeared only in a Yahoo/Tallahassee Democrat search snippet, which I did not open. Her statement is left out of the text above and is not cited. The state attorney's filing itself was not read; the WFLA report quotes it. No other controversies were searched. Her father Ron Book's lobbying and any campaign finance or donor questions were not reviewed.
